notes: Synthetic named-object WS RPC command whose venue injects a monotonic `nonce` into every call's `params`. Two recorded examples (`a`, `b`) differ only in their (redacted) `nonce`, so a live call carrying yet another `nonce` value matches both once `nonce` is stripped from both sides -- regression fixture for `match_rpc`'s `AmbiguousSubscriptionMatch` case. A `symbol` that does not match either example's `symbol` exercises the 'method recognized, params don't match' `UnexpectedSubscriptionParameters` case.

openapi.description: Returns stuff for one symbol over WS, on a venue that injects a monotonic nonce into every call.
